conf.description: BlueCat DDI dhcp / syslog-raw: hand-built regex pipeline over ISC dhcpd's free-text DORA/NAK/DECLINE/RELEASE/INFORM lines (no vendor pack; the ISC-dhcpd grok pattern set is the starting point), per recommendations.direct.cribl -- normalizes chaddr to uppercase dash-separated, tests the 'via' token for an IP so relayed requests land in network.forwarded_ip, and suppresses the 'Hostname Unsuitable for Printing' placeholder.

conf.comment: bluecat / dhcp / syslog-raw. ISC dhcpd lines forwarded on the same syslog stream as named querylog, discriminated by the 'dhcpd' tag. One generalized regex covers the on/for/of + to/from + via token positions shared by DISCOVER/OFFER/REQUEST/ACK/NAK/DECLINE/RELEASE/INFORM. Direct route, no guard hop.

functions.description: record dataset, format, and the generalized-verb-grammar approach
split the syslog header (BSD-style) from the dhcpd message body
parse the DHCP verb line into its positional slots (msgtype, on/for/of address, parenthetical 1, to/from address, parenthetical 2, via token, trailing reason)
batch-rename the clean mapped syslog-header fields to their ECS targets
derive ECS fields needing transforms: verb lowercasing, outcome, IP-vs-MAC slot disambiguation, chaddr normalization, via-token IP test, hostname-placeholder suppression
parse the BSD syslog timestamp into Cribl's canonical _time
